description: Savor the rich and creamy Paneer Tikka Masala, where succulent cubes of marinated paneer are grilled to perfection and enveloped in a velvety tomato-based sauce, infused with aromatic spices like cumin and coriander. This dish offers a delightful balance of smoky, tangy, and mildly spicy flavors that will tantalize your taste buds.
